faqs.q: What is the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female is a bulkhead connector that passes a tube through a panel and ends in a female NPT thread, in 316L stainless steel, forged. Its tube end uses a nut with a single ferrule that grips and seals on the outside of the tube. It is listed in 1/8" to 3/4" tube, in 7 part numbers.

faqs.q: How do I read the part numbers of the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female, such as IH-TF-CBF-2-2N-SF?
faqs.a: The number after the form code gives the size: IH-TF-CBF-2-2N-SF is 1/8" tube × 1/8" NPT (1/8-27) and IH-TF-CBF-12-12N-SF is 3/4" tube × 3/4" NPT (3/4-14). Quote the part number from the size table, or send the tube and thread sizes and the material, and we confirm the part number.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers does the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female cover?
faqs.a: The 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female is listed in 7 part numbers covering 1/8" to 3/4" tube. Tube end: 1/8" tube to 3/4" tube. Other end: 1/8" NPT (1/8-27) to 3/4" NPT (3/4-14).

faqs.q: How do I choose the size of the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female?
faqs.a: Choose the tube outside diameter first, then the NPT size, because each part number pairs one tube size with one NPT size, for example IH-TF-CBF-2-2N-SF. Check the thread type of the port before you order, because the wrong type will not seal.

faqs.q: What working pressure can the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female take?
faqs.a: A tube fitting is rated to the tube it is made up on, so the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female takes the pressure of the tube you fit. The manufacturer publishes working pressures for 316 stainless tubing from 2,000 psi on 7/8 inch tube up to 12,000 psi on 1/16 inch tube, depending on outside diameter and wall.

faqs.q: What is the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female made from?
faqs.a: The 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female is 316L stainless steel, forged, with bar stock to ASTM A479 and ASTM A276. 316L stainless steel resists corrosion in marine, chemical and process atmospheres far better than carbon steel, so it suits instrument and sampling lines on coastal sites.

faqs.q: Which standards does the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female follow?
faqs.a: The 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female follows these thread standards: NPT to ASME B1.20.1. The tube end is a single ferrule compression joint, and the pressure rating comes from the tube.

faqs.q: What does the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female connect to?
faqs.a: The tube end of the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female takes tube of the listed outside diameter, held by the nut and single ferrule. The other end is taper pipe thread that seals on the thread flanks, with sealant or tape. See the [316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Male Connector, Tube × NPT Male](/p/316-stainless-single-ferrule-bulkhead-male-connector-tube-x-npt-male) for the matching part.

faqs.a: For the 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Bulkhead Female Connector, Tube × NPT Female, fit the tube to the full depth of the fitting, make up the nut as the manufacturer instructs and do not reuse a ferrule that has been over-tightened. The other end is taper pipe thread that seals on the thread flanks, with sealant or tape.
